methods.label: Common denominator
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 5 common-denominator conversion and elementary same-denominator subtraction.

candidate.annotationRationale:
The target is unlike-denominator fraction subtraction (cnm_p173). The method converts both fractions to sixths (cnm_p172), then subtracts equal-denominator fractions (cnm_p080). Equivalent-fraction conversion relies on cnm_p167; cnm_p165 supports interpreting the common fractional unit.
